name: Love Days
source:
For young Tracy, high school is a time for new beginnings and a place to truly express oneself. Yet, when simply being herself undoubtedly lands her in trouble as always, she has to make the choice whether to stay or leave for the school day. From there, she realizes she's not alone, meeting like-minded people along the way. In this choice-based visual novel, whether Tracy plays by the rules or goes against the grain, she'll come to learn that high school is not only a time to find herself but a place to find new friendship and blossoming love, too.

[From [url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/love-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对年轻的特蕾西而言，高中是崭新开始的时节，也是真正展现自我的舞台。然而，当做真实的自己一如既往地给她惹来麻烦时，她不得不在留校上课与逃学离开之间做出抉择。以此为起点，她意识到自己并非孤身一人，并在一路上结识了志同道合的伙伴。在这部选择驱动的视觉小说中，无论特蕾西是循规蹈矩还是特立独行，她终将明白：高中不仅是找寻自我的时光，更是收获真挚友情与青涩恋情的园地。

[摘自[url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/love-days]itch.io[/url]]
